source.title: Forum Digest (November 2022)
source.content:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum in the second half of 2022.


[**Summarized Version of the WCA Regulations**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/summarised-version-of-the-wca-regulations/23927)
This thread proposes a summarized version of the entire regulations to make it easy for newer and/or young competitors to stay informed at competitions and to increase literacy with the regulations. The education resources on the WCA is one example of conveying regulations in an easy way.

[**Incentives for organizing series competitions**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/incentives-for-organizing-series-competitions/25638)
Series competitions are a solution to excessive competition demand. This thread goes into finding suggestions and ideas of having series competitions in dense cubing areas as opposed to more big competitions to cater to the local cubing community.

[**Unofficial WCA Languages announcement**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/unofficial-wca-languages-announcement/25113)
There are new subcategories for 5 languages, which are Arabic, German, Russian, Spanish and Swedish. The aim of this is for non-native English speakers to get introduced to the forums and pitch their feedback and ideas.

[**Allow competitors to opt-out of having their competition registration made public**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/allow-competitors-to-opt-out-of-having-their-competition-registration-made-public/22908)
This thread proposes a change to the registration process by not publicly showing registered competitors name.The goal of this change is to display competitors limits/status and their name optionally shown.

[**3D Printed Square-1 Cover to prevent misalignments**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/3d-printed-square-1-cover-to-prevent-misalignments-after-scrambling/22093)
This thread shows a solution of using 3D Printed Square-1 Cover to prevent misalignments after scrambling while it is brought to the solving station. It is a convenient solution and some organizers have started using it to save potential confusion at competitions.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

translation.title: WCA 论坛精选（2022 年 11 月）
translation.content:
以下是 2022 年下半年 WCA 论坛上值得关注的几个话题。

[**WCA 竞赛规则简明版**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/summarised-version-of-the-wca-regulations/23927)

该帖建议为整套规则制作简明版，让新选手和年纪较小的选手更容易了解比赛要求，提高大家对规则的熟悉程度。WCA 的教学资源就是用浅显方式说明规则的一个例子。

[**鼓励举办系列赛**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/incentives-for-organizing-series-competitions/25638)

系列赛可以缓解参赛需求过旺的问题。该帖讨论如何在魔友密集的地区举办系列赛，而不是继续增加大型比赛，以满足当地魔友的参赛需求。

[**WCA 非官方语言版块公告**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/unofficial-wca-languages-announcement/25113)

论坛新增了阿拉伯语、德语、俄语、西班牙语和瑞典语五个语言子版块，希望让英语非母语的成员更容易参与论坛，分享反馈和想法。

[**允许选手选择不公开报名信息**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/allow-competitors-to-opt-out-of-having-their-competition-registration-made-public/22908)

该帖建议修改报名流程，不再强制公开已报名选手的姓名，而是显示名额和报名状态，让选手自行选择是否展示姓名。

[**用 3D 打印 Square-1 魔方罩防止错位**](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/3d-printed-square-1-cover-to-prevent-misalignments-after-scrambling/22093)

该帖介绍了一种 3D 打印的 Square-1 魔方罩，可防止打乱后的魔方在送往还原桌途中错位。这是一种方便的办法，已有部分主办方采用，以减少比赛中可能出现的争议和困惑。

如有问题、意见或反馈，欢迎发送邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org。

感谢大家参与论坛！
